name: Ontario Wildlife Foundation Grant
summary: Grant for conservation and enhancement projects in Ontario that deliver a benefit to the local, regional or provincial community. Land purchases, staffing and travel to conferences are not funded.
reporting: The project coordinator submits a final report covering the project, how the funds were used and the benefit to the community; an interim report may be requested if the project runs into the following year.

geography.quote: The Ontario Wildlife Foundation mission is to raise funds and awareness for the conservation and enhancement of Ontario's natural resources through research and restoration.

access.quote: All applications are to be submitted by email to: OWF program Coordinator at owf@ontwf.org

reporting.quote: Your project coordinator must submit a final report to the OWF including details of the project, an outline of how the OWF funds were used and the benefit(s) to the community.
